title: NVIDIA, National Science Foundation Support Ai2 Development of Open AI Models to Drive U.S. Scientific Leadership
description: NVIDIA is partnering with the U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF) to create an AI system that supports the development of multimodal language models for advancing scientific research in the United States.
